name: Leverblow
description: Cup the iron shell in the open palm with the fuse hole turned outward and the thumb pressing it steady.

name: Kaboombump
description: Touch the glowing slow-match to the fuse mouth and wait for the first hiss before lifting the shell.

name: Sudden Pinring
description: Swing the straight arm up from the hip and release the shell on a high arc toward the target.

name: Raised Casing
description: Drop to one knee right after release and tuck the chin so the body shrinks behind its own cover.

name: Steady Powderchamber
description: Bark one short fixed word at release so nearby comrades turn their faces away and crouch before the blast.

name: Planted Fragment
description: Stay low under cover after a throw that makes no bang and count slowly before anyone approaches the shell.

name: Backward Shockwave
description: Slide the hand under the pouch flap and lift one shell out without taking the eyes from the target.

name: Sizzleblow
description: Blow once across the glowing slow-match to freshen its tip before it is touched to the fuse.

name: Even Fuse
description: Pinch the fuse between two fingers and judge how much is left by feel before committing to the throw.

name: Spoonstrike
description: Turn the hip before the arm follows so the shell leaves the hand on a flat quick path.

name: Quiet Cap
description: Step back one pace while the free hand reaches the pouch so the next shell is ready before the blast.

name: Settled Lever
description: Turn the face and shoulder from the target at the instant of burst to guard the eyes from sparks.

name: Swaying Spoon
description: Advance through the grey smoke a burst leaves behind so its cover hides the grenadier on the approach.

name: Level Shrapnel
description: Swing the arm low and release at the knee so the shell bounces and rolls along the ground to the target.

name: Forward Concussion
description: Plant both feet and throw high so the shell drops steeply on the far side of a low barrier.

name: Settled Fragment
description: Lock the lead knee hard as the arm finishes so the throw ends with the body upright and steady.

name: Cappause
description: Fold below the lip of a ditch the moment the shell leaves the hand and stay folded through the blast.

name: Steady Fuse
description: Tally the burning fuse aloud in a flat voice so the throw is gone from the hand before the last number.

name: Sizzlestrike
description: Sight along the lead shoulder at the target and hold that line through the whole arm swing.

name: Square Detonate
description: Raise the elbow to shoulder height and cock the wrist back so the shell rides behind the ear.

name: Spoonhit
description: Whip the forearm forward and snap the wrist open so the shell leaves cleanly toward the aim.

name: Sharp Detonate
description: Flick the wrist upward at release to lift the shell over a roof edge or a stacked cart.

name: Sideways Fragmentation
description: Take one long stride into the throw so the whole body weight drives the shell to the far mark.

name: Even Firecap
description: Measure by eye how far iron splinters will fly and place friends and self beyond that distance.

name: Casingcowl
description: Throw the body flat and slide behind the nearest low mound with the feet toward the blast.

name: Holding Firecap
description: Snatch a shell that lands short with a gloved hand and fling it back before its fuse burns out.

name: Low Lever
description: Throw weighted dummy shells at a chalk mark again and again until the release point never drifts.

name: Descending Sizzle
description: Brace the spine and hurl the shell with the whole frame so it clears a long open space.

name: Holding Shrapnel
description: Release the shell and fall to the ground in one motion so no breath passes between throw and cover.

name: Single Shockwave
description: Lean out from a corner and toss the shell low along the ground to reach foes behind the angle.

name: Fusewedge
description: Press a palm to one ear and open the mouth slightly to ease the ring of a near blast.

name: Levercount
description: Tap the pouch to feel how many shells remain and decide whether to throw or hold.

name: Mild Spoon
description: Match one slow breath to each beat of the burning fuse so the count stays calm and exact.

name: Fusedash
description: Hold the lit shell until about half the fuse has burned and then loft it so it bursts on landing.

name: Even Cap
description: Read the colour of a freshly cut fuse end and refuse any shell whose spark looks too quick.

name: Pinring Blow
description: Let a thread of qi warm the palm so the sweating hand never loses its grip on the shell.

name: Swaying Concussion
description: Pivot on the rear foot at the last count and throw while already turning toward cover.

name: Measured Casing
description: Listen for the echo of the blast to learn whether the shell fell where it was aimed.

name: Powderchamber Pause
description: Stay behind cover through a quiet fuse until the full count has run twice over.

name: Upward Kaboom
description: Roll the shell along flat ground with an even forward spin so it keeps a straight line.

name: Watching Lever
description: Read ruts and rocks in the path so a bowled shell is placed to roll true and not veer.

name: Open Fragmentation
description: Slide forward in a low crouch and bowl the shell under the rail of a barricade.

name: Straight Cap
description: Let the breath out slowly through the whole bowl so the arm stays loose and the aim stays level.

name: Spoonhop
description: Push off the toes and back away from a bowled shell while keeping the eyes on its rolling path.

name: Sizzlebump
description: Lean out from behind a pillar to throw and snap back into cover before any answering shot lands.

name: Tight Fragment
description: Rest the forearm across a crate top so the throw is steady while the head stays below the edge.

name: Leverhit
description: Throw one shell then draw the next in the same breath so the pitch never stops.

name: Downward Spoon
description: Skip the shell off the floor through an open doorway so it comes to rest inside the room.

name: Hitching Sizzle
description: Pinch out a shell fuse between gloved fingers when a throw must be called off at once.

name: Watching Fuse
description: Call the count to a covering partner so both fighters know when the burst will come.

name: Shifting Pinring
description: Slip sideways into the smoke of a fresh burst to break the line of sight of enemy shooters.

name: Casingstay
description: Crouch in the angle of two stacked crates so splinters from a burst pass over the head.

name: Soft Firecap
description: Settle the bandolier across the chest and feel each shell lie flat so none can knock together.

name: Stepping Kaboom
description: Pull a shell across the body with the off hand and bring it to the throwing hand in one motion.

name: Stepping Detonate
description: Run with the elbow clamped to the bandolier so the shells stay still and the stride stays free.

name: Settled Casing
description: Slip the strap free with one pull and let a smouldering bandolier fall clear of the body.

name: Leverwedge
description: Roll onto the shoulder when diving so the shells on the chest are not struck against the ground.

name: Shrapnel Count
description: Count shells by touch from the lowest pouch upward so the oldest and driest are thrown first.

name: Hard Shockwave
description: Run a thin trace of qi along the forearm so the arm swings faster and tires more slowly.

name: Level Powderchamber
description: Let qi surge into the fingertips at the instant of release to add a few more paces to the throw.

name: Upward Sizzle
description: Loft the shell on a steep arc so it drops over a tall barrier and lands among the defenders.

name: Casingblow
description: Bounce the shell off a rising slope so it hops up and over the lip into the hollow beyond.

name: Leveramble
description: Square the feet to the target before each pitch so the hips open cleanly into the arm swing.

name: Steady Shrapnel
description: Study the ground where the shell fell to learn how far the next throw must be shortened or lengthened.

name: Hooding Fuse
description: Roll away from the throwing spot at once so a returning shot finds only empty ground.

name: Flat Kaboom
description: Keep one steady thread of qi in the wrist from lighting to release so the fingers never tremble.

name: Stout Cap
description: Release on the same beat of the count each time so every shell bursts at the planned spot.

name: Leverstrike
description: Throw by memory of the target bearing through thick smoke without lifting the head to look.

name: Casinghusk
description: Hold the circulation low and the body still in shelter so the blast finds nothing to unsettle.

name: Light Casing
description: Sidestep twice in the stride before throwing so aimed fire from the foe misses the thrower.

name: Capwedge
description: Approach a silent shell low and slow and pinch its fuse dead before lifting it from the ground.
